data.standardized_narrative: Unable to confidently extract a single gross prioryear reserve movement from the document images provided. The balance sheet (liabilities / technical provisions) shows gross claims outstanding at the 2017 year end of approximately GBP 254.1m (used here as opening reserves). The report contains a claims development table and related notes, but the images are not sufficiently legible to extract and reconcile a definitive gross prioryear movement or to attribute it to specific causes or lines of business.
data.data_quality_notes: Document images are rotated and low-resolution in places. The balance sheet liability line for "claims outstanding" at 31 Dec 2017 was interpreted as GBP 254.1m from the liabilities/technical provisions area (page ~9) but legibility is limited. No clear, unambiguous GROSS "movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" note or a plainly readable gross claims development triangle could be reliably parsed from the images; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is set to null. The gross written premium figure (555.2) and its page (1) were clearly visible in the highlights. Recommend providing higher-resolution, properly oriented PDF pages for precise extraction of the movement note, claims development triangle, segmental premium mix and event-level reserve impacts.
